description: 1. Agent discovers xclip from SKILL.md and sets DISPLAY=:99 (Xvfb already running). 2. Agent runs `xclip -selection clipboard < logs/current/access.log` to load the full log into the clipboard (using the file-redirect form from SKILL.md). 3. Agent runs `xclip -selection clipboard -o` to retrieve clipboard contents, pipes through grep/awk to filter lines containing ' 200 ', capturing only HTTP 200 lines (10 lines from the seeded data). 4. Agent pipes those filtered lines back into `xclip -selection clipboard` (echo/pipe form). 5. Agent reads from clipboard again with `xclip -selection clipboard -o`, counts lines (OK_REQUESTS=10) and extracts unique first-field IPs (UNIQUE_IPS=5: 192.168.1.10, 10.0.0.5, 172.16.0.3, 192.168.1.15, 10.0.0.12). 6. Writes report with exact format `OK_REQUESTS: 10\nUNIQUE_IPS: 5`. The proprietary trap is the `-selection clipboard` flag — omitting it uses PRIMARY selection which is a different buffer and `xclip -o` without the flag would read from PRIMARY, making the relay produce empty or wrong output.
